_doc: kdd28_wide_real_candidates: real public datasets with F >= 100 features (after ID columns) screened for 'single SPO-GBT clearly beats AA-GBT' (2026-11-22, user request). Not part of kdd28_wide_datasets. Built by benchmarks/data/prep_wide_real_candidate_folds.py <out_dir>, checked by benchmarks/data/check_wide_real_candidate_folds.py <out_dir>. sha256 of raw and fold files in kdd28_wide_real_candidates_manifest.sha256.
encoding: benchmarks/src/spaa27_experiments/make_train_nan.py encode_features_keep_nan: numeric -> float32, bool -> 0/1, datetime -> epoch s, categorical/string -> ordinal codes over the sorted distinct values (as strings). No scaling. Only ID columns listed in drop_columns are removed, constant and duplicate columns stay.
labels: benchmarks/data/tabular_suite_prep.py encode_binary_label: two classes -> majority 0, >2 classes -> majority-vs-rest (1 iff the row's class is the most frequent, ties -> smaller value as a string). Regression: float label passed through.
folds: run_suite.make_folds (unchanged). cv5: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) for classification, KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) for regression. shipped: the source's own train/test split as one holdout fold k=0 (rows written train first, then test, and split by make_folds' file-order holdout path with holdout_frac = n_test / n_total). NaN -> training-fold column mean, test reuses it, all-NaN -> 0.0.

datasets.name: jasmine
datasets.note: ChaLearn AutoML round 1. Domain undisclosed by the organisers.

datasets.name: madeline
datasets.note: ChaLearn AutoML round 1. FLAG: may be artificial (MADELON-like generator). Hypothesis, unverified in this run: the AutoML challenge analysis table was not retrievable.

datasets.name: gina_agnostic
datasets.note: Agnostic Learning vs Prior Knowledge challenge: MNIST odd vs even, smashed pixels.

datasets.name: sylva_agnostic
datasets.note: Agnostic challenge: forest cover type (Colorado). v2 stores binary features as factors (ordinal-encoded here, order preserved). OpenML declares no default target, the column is 'label'.

datasets.name: musk
datasets.note: UCI Musk v2. ID = OpenML row_id_attribute, conformation_name = OpenML ignore_attribute, molecule_name = molecule identifier whose text starts with MUSK- or NON-MUSK- (prefix = label in 6598/6598 rows, measured 2026-11-22). FLAG grouped: 102 molecules, conformations of one molecule land in train and test folds.

datasets.name: semeion
datasets.note: UCI Semeion handwritten digits, 16x16 binary pixels, about 80 writers (FLAG: writer ids not shipped, writers may span folds).

datasets.name: mfeat-factors
datasets.note: UCI Multiple Features, profile correlations, 10 balanced digit classes.

datasets.name: gisette
datasets.note: NIPS 2003 feature selection challenge (UCI 170). Shipped labelled split: gisette_train (6000) = train, gisette_valid (1000) = test. The challenge test set (6500) has no labels and is unused. FLAG: half of the 5000 features are random 'probes' added by the organisers on top of real MNIST 4-vs-9 pixel features.

datasets.name: Fashion-MNIST
datasets.note: Zalando originals (OpenML 40996 is the same data merged). Shipped split 60k/10k. 10 classes of 7000: majority-vs-rest tie -> class '0' (T-shirt/top) by the string tie rule.

datasets.name: har
datasets.note: UCI HAR (240). Shipped subject-disjoint split (21 train / 9 test volunteers). Subject ids live in separate files and are not features. Column names f000..f560 (features.txt names contain commas and duplicates).

datasets.name: isolet
datasets.note: UCI ISOLET (54). Shipped speaker-disjoint split isolet1+2+3+4 (120 speakers) / isolet5 (30 speakers). 26 letter classes.

datasets.name: ct_slices
datasets.note: UCI Relative location of CT slices on axial axis (206), target 'reference'. FLAG grouped: 97 distinct patientId values (measured 2026-11-22), KFold puts slices of one patient in train and test.

datasets.name: blogfeedback
datasets.note: UCI BlogFeedback (304). Shipped temporal split: blogData_train.csv (2010-2011) = train, the 60 blogData_test-2012.*.csv files concatenated in file-name (date) order = test. Target = comments in the next 24 h, raw counts.

excluded.riccardo: AUC ceiling: every AutoML tool scores 1.000 test AUC in AMLB (Gijsbers et al., arXiv 2207.12560), so an edge > 0.005 is impossible
excluded.hill-valley: synthetic: each row is a generated 100-point curve (UCI/OpenML description), not real data
excluded.scene: multi-label with the other five labels stored as features in the OpenML copy, and the original Mulan split ships only as a .rar archive. Dropped to keep the candidate list to sets the standards cover cleanly
